key_insight: Neuron-OPSD uses internal neuron activations to choose better training data and build a stronger teacher, enabling annotation-free self-distillation that improves specialized-domain performance without relying on labels.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical post-training recipe for deploying LLMs in expert domains where human annotation or online feedback is expensive, while aiming to preserve generalization and calibration.
method: Select training examples using neuron-activation signals instead of labels.
Construct teacher context from neuron-aware data selection and extra context.
Train the student with on-policy distillation from the teacher distribution, using no ground-truth labels.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains on specialized-domain benchmarks, with improved in-domain performance, preserved cross-domain generalization, and reduced calibration collapse versus prior annotation-free baselines.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on internal activations and on-policy distillation, it may be sensitive to model architecture, activation extraction overhead, and the quality of the selected context.
paper_title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation
